scope: Complete regular-file snapshot identity of two selected ZIP distributions, before fixed-synthetic probe execution; not runtime isolation.

archiveInventory.treeAlgorithm: SHA256(JSON.stringify(sorted [relative POSIX path,file byte length,SHA256(file bytes)] rows)); ordinal UTF-16 path order; files only

covered: Dependency mutation while original entrypoint stays unchanged
Unexpected logger configuration file and missing resource
Directory junction rejected rather than followed

limits: Snapshot check and execution are not atomic; a concurrent writer could alter files after checking. No locking, OS containment or network block.
Only regular file paths/sizes/contents in selected roots are fingerprinted; empty directories, ACLs, registry, filesystem metadata and external/global state are not.
Rejects symlink/junction entries inside roots and root itself, but does not comprehensively audit every ancestor reparse point or OS loader search path.
Does not attest external agents, providers, configurations, native/system libraries, live class loading or platform side effects.
Raw output remains transiently present in process memory. Owned-temp removal is not secure erasure or comprehensive retention cleanup.
Exact snapshot match is not a dependency-vulnerability, license, no-training or privacy certification.
Probe still accepts fixed synthetic texts only; no real-document workflow validation.
decision: Closes the earlier two-file-only identity gap for the selected distribution file snapshots. All prior privacy qualifications remain on hold.
ownerAction: Apply eight files, run pure Node reviews/tests; no Java download, probe rerun, admin capture or SQL required.
